title: Sales Marketing Executive
description:
We are looking for a Marketing Executive to develop and grow our market for Textile Screen Printing Inks.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Develop new customers and expand existing business.
 



 \* Visit garment printing units, textile printers and garment manufacturers.
 



 \* Generate leads and convert them into regular business.
 



 \* Conduct product trials and coordinate with the technical/R\&D team.
 



 \* Understand customer printing requirements and provide suitable ink solutions.
 



 \* Handle customer follow\-ups, quotations and orders.
 



  





  





 Candidate Profile
 



  





 \* Experience in Textile Printing Inks / Textile Chemicals / Screen Printing preferred.
 



 \* Good communication, negotiation and customer\-handling skills.
 



 \* Basic understanding of textile printing processes.
 



 \* Willingness to travel extensively.
 



 \* Self\-driven and target\-oriented.
